persona.name: ALICE
persona.description: composed, precise, lightly dry, warm underneath: a British woman who runs the house with quiet authority. Never chatty, never sycophantic.
persona._help: name shows on the glass and is how the brain refers to itself; acronym is the subtitle (may be empty); description is the personality the brain plays; voice = a `say -v ?` name on macOS or a Piper .onnx path on Linux; tts = say|piper|none|auto; wake_model = any openWakeWord pretrained model (hey_jarvis, alexa, hey_mycroft, hey_rhasspy) or a path to a custom-trained model

brain._help: provider = anthropic | openai. Keys live in the macOS Keychain, never here: account jarvis-mirror, service anthropic-key (or openai-key).

_sources_help: Enable only what you have. Extras that need Simon-style local projects: signals, scouts, ci, appstore, queues, onthisday.
